why: This is a single synchronized online robotics course implementation for inservice teachers, not a reusable instructional element or named adoptable product.
The LBCS is a named, validated assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: Long-Term Breastfeeding Competence Scale (LBCS)
product_description: The LBCS is a Finnish-context self-report scale developed by Pöyhönen et al. to assess public health nurses' knowledge, skills, and attitudes for breastfeeding counselling beyond 12 months.
